# re-enters a client's snapshot. map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as

# Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29261 SECS=75 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_cull mp_carentan
